purpose: Exact immutable identifiers for the Q0 clean-container replay image. Never a floating tag. Never 'latest'.

platform.note: Built and verified on aarch64 (Apple Silicon host via Colima). x86_64 would need different solver/elan artifact URLs and sha256s.

lean_for_mathlib_checks.role: toolchain used to machine-check Mathlib-dependent capsules (matches Mathlib lean-toolchain at the pinned commit)
lean_for_mathlib_checks.why_not_4_32_1: Mathlib at commit 2ec0166b31100827cd34bacca4d3b9ea3da9d618 declares leanprover/lean4:v4.33.0-rc1. A Mathlib pin is meaningless against a Lean that Mathlib will not load.

lean_host_default_recorded_in_lock.role: host elan default recorded in RAMANUJAN_ENVIRONMENT_LOCK.json components.lean
lean_host_default_recorded_in_lock.note: Installed into the image for pin parity with the lock, but capsule replay against Mathlib uses lean_for_mathlib_checks.

probe_theorem.name: two_plus_two
probe_theorem.source: lock proof_it_works; the formal system proves 2+2=4 by machine check

image_tag_policy: tag = mathlib short SHA (8 hex). Never 'latest'.
